numbers/float#

The shortest decimal that reads back as exactly a float.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ShortestFloat(0.1).decimal().string();       // "1e-1": 0.1, not 0.1000000000000000055…

Description#

The shortest decimal that reads back as exactly a float.

The decimal is chosen within the float's exact round-to-nearest interval, so printing and parsing round-trip. Zero keeps its sign.
